'''2008 Worlds Day 3 Kevin Shannon DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 3). Sheet name Kevin Shannon (title Dingus ROPS).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
